meta.name: codebase-scan
meta.description: Create a high-level map of the project structure and identify architectural pillars, entry points, and module boundaries. Activate at Bootstrap initialization or before architecture extraction.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描项目结构并生成架构地图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想快速了解项目整体架构
copy.tagline_en: Generate a high-level map of your project structure
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly understand the overall project architecture

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会扫描整个代码仓库，生成项目结构地图（目录树）和关键文件列表，帮助了解代码的组织方式和核心模块。
howto.when: 当你初始化项目、在进行架构提取前，或对项目结构不明确时，Claude 会自动触发扫描。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个项目，列出所有关键文件和模块边界。
say.note: Claude 会生成项目树和关键文件列表。

say.text: 我想了解代码库的整体架构，先做个扫描。
say.note: Claude 会快速扫描并输出结构地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude scans the entire code repository, generating a project structure map (directory tree) and list of key files to help understand code organization and core modules.
howto.when_en: Triggered during project initialization, before architecture extraction, or when the project structure is unknown.

say_en.text: Scan this project and list all key files and module boundaries.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a project tree and key file list.

say_en.text: I need an overview of the codebase architecture, start with a scan.
say_en.note: Claude will quickly scan and output a structural map.
